title: repair step answer
description: A red or clashing pull request, repaired on its own branch. Every fix carries its proof: a test the driver re-runs red-then-green, or — for a fix no test can pin, such as a lint or type error — the gate command the driver re-runs at the new head, and why no test can pin it.

skills.description: Every Superpowers skill invoked in this step. The driver cross-checks this against the Skill calls in the run log, so a claim here the log does not show is a failed step.

cause.description: What was actually wrong, in a line: the root cause, not the symptom the check printed.

conflicts.description: Each file that conflicted when the integration branch was merged in, and how both sides' intent was kept.

command.description: For a test proof, the command that runs the test. For a gate proof, the gate command that was red and is now green.

redWhen.description: The production change that makes this test fail — the fix deleted, not a typo introduced. A test whose author cannot name one is measuring the shape of the code.

testCommit.description: The commit that added the test. The driver re-runs it at implCommit's parent and at implCommit.

implCommit.description: The commit that made it pass; never testCommit.

noTestBecause.description: For a gate proof only: why no test can pin this fix. A behaviour change always has a test.

question.description: Why this step cannot finish. Answerable in a line: a yes/no or a pick.

replacedTests.description: Every test file in which this step removed, reworded or skipped an it()/test() case. `file` is the repo-relative path exactly as git shows it. Give exactly one of `coveredBy` — a bare repo-relative path, nothing else, to the test file at head that now pins the same behaviour (the same file, for a reworded case) — or `removedBecause`, one line on why the behaviour is gone. The ship step writes these into the pull request's `## Deleted tests` section, and the deleted-tests gate checks each line. Empty when no case was removed, reworded or skipped.

reason.description: For unchanged only: why the pull request needs no change — the brief is already met, and nothing is red or clashing.

lesson.description: Only when the lesson check is red: the `## Lesson` the driver writes into the pull request body. `guard` is one path to an executable test the diff adds or changes in substance: a test the PR already carries, or one this repair added and reports under `fixes` with proof test (red, then green). The driver re-runs the lesson check on the body before it writes it.

principle.description: One sentence naming the class of mistake, not the instance.

guard.description: The repo-relative path of the test that guards it, bare (no backticks).

beforeAfter.description: How the guard fails on the pre-fix code and passes on the fix.

reach.description: The sibling the guard also catches, or the search that found none.
